name: Home Assistant Panel
description: Connect to Home Assistant and display entity values in the top bar. Trigger automations directly from your GNOME desktop.

ha-url.description: Home Assistant URL (include http:// or https://)

ha-token.description: Long-lived access token from Home Assistant

display-entities.description: List of entity IDs to display in the panel

show-icon.description: Show Home Assistant icon in panel

automations.description: List of automation entities to trigger
